traf.translation: abbr. traffic 交通; 通行; 运输; 贸易

trafalgar.definition: n. a naval battle in 1805 off the southwest coast of Spain; the French and Spanish fleets were defeated by the English under Nelson (who was mortally wounded)

traffic.definition:
n. the aggregation of things (pedestrians or vehicles) coming and going in a particular locality during a specified period of time
n. buying and selling; especially illicit trade
n. the amount of activity over a communication system during a given period of time
v. deal illegally
traffic.translation:
n. 交通, 通行, 运输, 交通量, 贸易, 交易, 交往, 通信量
vi. 交易, 做买卖
vt. 用...作交换
[计] 通信量, 传输量

traffic circle.translation: n. 圆环, 道路的圆形交叉路口

traffic concentration.translation: [计] 信息量集中, 通信量集中

traffic cone.translation: 锥形交通路标, 交通锥标

traffic congestion.translation: [计] 通信量拥挤, 信息量拥挤, 交通拥塞

traffic control.translation: [经] 交通管理, 运输管理, 厂内运输管理

traffic department.translation: [经] 运输部门, 运输科

traffic engineer.translation: 交通工程师, 运输工程师

traffic light.translation:
红绿灯
[法] 交通指挥灯

traffic load.translation: [计] 通信负载, 交通负载

traffic manager.translation:
[计] 通信量管理程序
[经] 运输经理, 运输科长

traffic orphan.translation: [法] 交通事故的造的孤儿

traffic rate.translation: [计] 通信速率, 信息速率

traffic signal.translation: 交通信号, 交通管理色灯, 红绿灯

traffic tetris.definition:
When you come to a stoplight and make the conscious decision to avoid getting behind a dumptruck or semi and opt for the lane with 10 vehicles instead of just two so you're sure to move sooner when the light turns green.
> Oh no! I got stuck behind the tow truck at the red light. I need to brush up on my "Traffic Tetris" skills.

traffic ticket.translation: [法] 对汽车驾驶员违反交通规则的传票

traffic utilization.translation: [计] 通信量利用, 信息量利用

traffic utilization parameter.translation: [计] 通信量利用参数, 信息量利用参数

traffic-jams.translation: (traffic-jam 的复数) n. 交通阻塞

traffic-lights.translation: (traffic-light 的复数) 红绿灯（等于traffic signals）

trafficability.translation: 通过能力; 车辆通过性

trafficable.definition: a. Capable of being disposed of in traffic; marketable.
trafficable.translation: 适于通行的,适于交易的

trafficator.definition: n a blinking light on a motor vehicle that indicates the direction in which the vehicle is about to turn

trafficked.translation: vt. 用…作交换（traffic的过去式与过去分词形式）

trafficker.definition: n someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money
trafficker.translation:
n. 商人, 贩子
[法] 贩卖者, 买卖者, 商人

traffickers.definition: n. someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money
traffickers.translation: n. 商人, 贩子( trafficker的复数形式 ); 做（非法）买卖的人

trafficking.definition:
v deal illegally
v trade or deal a commodity

trafficless.definition: a. Destitute of traffic, or trade.
trafficless.translation: a. 无交通往来的, 无通信的

traffics.definition:
n the aggregation of things (pedestrians or vehicles) coming and going in a particular locality during a specified period of time
n buying and selling; especially illicit trade
n the amount of activity over a communication system during a given period of time
n social or verbal interchange (usually followed by `with')
v deal illegally
v trade or deal a commodity
traffics.translation: n. 流动的车辆[行人], 交通( traffic的名词复数 ); （非法的）交易, 买卖; （沿固定路线的）航行, 行驶, 飞行; 运输, 人流, 货流

trafficway.translation: 开放通行的道路, 公路

trafford.translation: n. 特拉福德（姓氏）；特拉福德（英格兰的一个都市自治市）

traffuck.definition:
Peak hour traffic or any general traffic which slows you down.
> Im late for work and im stuck in traffuck.
